mapper.sql: A.CARE_ARTCL_SN , A.CARE_ARTCL_NM , A.CARE_ZONE_CD , A.CARE_CYCLE_CD , Y.COM_CD_NM AS CARE_CYCLE_CD_NM , A.CYCLE_DRCT_INPT_DAY_CNT , A.RPRS_ICON_ID , A.NXTM_PRNMNT_YMD , A.LAST_CMPTN_YMD , CASE WHEN A.MAIN_EXPSR_YN = 'Y' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS MAIN_EXPSR_YN , A.MAIN_SORT_SEQ , CASE WHEN A.BSC_ARTCL_YN = 'Y' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS BSC_ARTCL_YN , A.PRSC_SN , A.REPT_PRVNT_MNG_SN , COALESCE(P.CKUP_RCD_SN, R.CKUP_RCD_SN) AS CKUP_RCD_SN , P.MDCN_END_YMD , P.DAY_MDCN_NMTM , ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(H.CMPTN_CYCL), 0) FROM CARE_CMPTN_HSTRY H WHERE H.CARE_ARTCL_SN = A.CARE_ARTCL_SN AND H.CMPTN_YMD = #{today} AND H.DEL_YN = 'N' ) AS TODAY_CMPTN_CNT
mapper.select: /* 반려동물 기본 케어 항목 수, 잠금 읽기로 다른 트랜잭션의 최신 기록까지 반영 */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CARE_ARTCL WHERE PET_SN = #{petSn} AND BSC_ARTCL_YN = 'Y' AND DEL_YN = 'N' FOR UPDATE

/* 케어 항목 목록 조회 */ SELECT
FROM CARE_ARTCL A LEFT JOIN COM_CD Y ON Y.COM_CD = A.CARE_CYCLE_CD LEFT JOIN PRSC P ON P.PRSC_SN = A.PRSC_SN AND P.DEL_YN = 'N' LEFT JOIN REPT_PRVNT_MNG R ON R.REPT_PRVNT_MNG_SN = A.REPT_PRVNT_MNG_SN AND R.DEL_YN = 'N' WHERE A.PET_SN = #{petSn} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N'
AND A.MAIN_EXPSR_YN = 'Y'
AND A.MAIN_EXPSR_YN = 'N'
AND A.CARE_ARTCL_NM = #{cond.careArtclNm}
ORDER BY A.MAIN_SORT_SEQ , A.CARE_ARTCL_SN
ORDER BY CASE WHEN A.CARE_ZONE_CD = #{regularCd} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END , A.CARE_ARTCL_SN

/* 케어 항목 단건 조회 */ SELECT
FROM CARE_ARTCL A LEFT JOIN COM_CD Y ON Y.COM_CD = A.CARE_CYCLE_CD LEFT JOIN PRSC P ON P.PRSC_SN = A.PRSC_SN AND P.DEL_YN = 'N' LEFT JOIN REPT_PRVNT_MNG R ON R.REPT_PRVNT_MNG_SN = A.REPT_PRVNT_MNG_SN AND R.DEL_YN = 'N' WHERE A.CARE_ARTCL_SN = #{careArtclSn} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N'

/* 케어 항목 잠금 조회 */ SELECT CARE_ARTCL_SN , PRSC_SN , REPT_PRVNT_MNG_SN , PET_SN , CARE_ZONE_CD , CARE_CYCLE_CD , CYCLE_DRCT_INPT_DAY_CNT , CARE_ARTCL_NM , RPRS_ICON_ID , NXTM_PRNMNT_YMD , LAST_CMPTN_YMD , MAIN_EXPSR_YN , MAIN_SORT_SEQ , BSC_ARTCL_YN , DEL_YN , REG_DT , MDFCN_DT , RGTR_ID , MDFR_ID FROM CARE_ARTCL WHERE CARE_ARTCL_SN = #{careArtclSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N' FOR UPDATE

/* 케어 완료 기록 단건 조회 */ SELECT CARE_CMPTN_HSTRY_SN , CARE_ARTCL_SN , MBR_SN , CMPTN_CYCL , CMPTN_YMD , DEL_YN , REG_DT , MDFCN_DT , MDFR_ID FROM CARE_CMPTN_HSTRY WHERE CARE_CMPTN_HSTRY_SN = #{careCmptnHstrySn} AND DEL_YN = 'N'

/* 케어 완료 기록 잠금 조회 */ SELECT CARE_CMPTN_HSTRY_SN , CARE_ARTCL_SN , MBR_SN , CMPTN_CYCL , CMPTN_YMD , DEL_YN , REG_DT , MDFCN_DT , MDFR_ID FROM CARE_CMPTN_HSTRY WHERE CARE_CMPTN_HSTRY_SN = #{careCmptnHstrySn} AND DEL_YN = 'N' FOR UPDATE

/* 항목의 완료일 기록 잠금 조회, 삭제된 기록 포함 */ SELECT CARE_CMPTN_HSTRY_SN , CARE_ARTCL_SN , MBR_SN , CMPTN_CYCL , CMPTN_YMD , DEL_YN , REG_DT , MDFCN_DT , MDFR_ID FROM CARE_CMPTN_HSTRY WHERE CARE_ARTCL_SN = #{careArtclSn} AND CMPTN_YMD = #{cmptnYmd} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: /* 케어 완료 기록 등록, 삭제된 같은 날짜 기록은 되살림 */ INSERT INTO CARE_CMPTN_HSTRY ( CARE_ARTCL_SN , MBR_SN , CMPTN_CYCL , CMPTN_YMD , DEL_YN , REG_DT , MDFCN_DT , MDFR_ID ) VALUES ( #{careArtclSn} , #{mbrSn} , #{cmptnCycl} , #{cmptnYmd} , 'N' , NOW() , NOW() , #{mbrSn} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE MBR_SN = VALUES(MBR_SN) , CMPTN_CYCL = VALUES(CMPTN_CYCL) , DEL_YN = 'N' , MDFR_ID = VALUES(MDFR_ID) , MDFCN_DT = NOW()
